stories.title: Hero firefighter saves three-day-old boy after family races to station with newborn not breathing
stories.summary: A Belhar firefighter successfully performed CPR on a three-day-old baby. The infant was brought to the station unresponsive and not breathing, but the firefighter brought him to life.
stories.angle: This story highlights the quick thinking and life-saving skills of a dedicated public servant.
